text:
Mira: quick sync — need to lock lanes for the Q3 pragmatic-lanes initiative. Customer asks are pushing private deploy + low-latency. We have runtime, infra, and security dependencies. Who's got immediate blockers?
Alex: runtime here. Biggest blocker: validating 4-bit quant kernels across our model family. Plan is kernel bench + small e2e; estimate 2 weeks validation.
Sofia: infra note — hosted capacity is fine, but Dedicated/reserved pools need slot reservations and VPC egress rules. HSM certing for private deployments is a separate path (3w). Need tickets.
Dan: security — HSM/KMS integration requires design review + compliance checklist. Can we scope an initial canary that does not require customer HSM to reduce time-to-canary?
Mira: yes — product ok with a canary without enforced HSM for low-risk customers. We need a clear rollback and an opt-in flag for customers who require HSM.
Kevin: platform will own the flag. I'll add a feature flag `require_hsm` with canary rollout. Need acceptance criteria from product and a safety fallback to the next model variant if HSM calls fail.
Luis: product acceptance criteria: P50 latency under 120ms for single-turn chat for canary customers, no regressions on our hallucination eval set (baseline), and successful toggle of `require_hsm` in staging. Docs + onboarding checklist required for any customers opting into HSM.
Alex: timeline suggestion: week1 kernel bench + infra perf tests, week2 e2e with KV cache and prewarm, week3 canary rollout. If infra can get reserved slots earlier we can parallelize.
Sofia: I can carve the slot reservations in parallel but need the exact GPU type + expected qps. Can we lock GPU type today?
Mira: target is GA3/16GB (q4 equivalent) for Dedicated pilot. Expected QPS ~25/sec for initial tenant mix.
Dan: to unblock security review faster — share a minimal compliance checklist. We can do a lightweight review for canary, full SOC docs for GA.
Kevin: putting up a quick config sample for the flag and fallback.
Kevin: feature_flags:
  require_hsm: false # default for canary, true for strict tenants
fallback_policy:
  on_hsm_error: use_software_kms
Mira: great. Also add an SLA/rollback playbook doc stub in the ticket: what to do if latency spikes > 2x baseline or error rate > 1%.
Alex: noted. One more runtime blocker: model quant profiles — if quant changes quality we need a fast rollback to fp16 variant. Can the routing layer support per-tenant model variant pins?
Kevin: yes, routing already supports per-tenant pins. I'll add a temporary rule to prefer fp16 if quality regression > threshold.
Sofia: infra follow-ups: I'll create tickets for reserved slots, VPC egress rules, and staging HSM endpoint. Need owners for each.
Mira: assign owners: Alex -> runtime validation, Sofia -> infra tickets, Dan -> security checklist + review, Kevin -> feature flag + routing rules, Luis -> acceptance criteria + docs. I'll sync with sales for customer selection for canary.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: PLAT-789 "feature flag: require_hsm" assigned to Kevin.
Luis: thanks, will draft onboarding + acceptance tests today and attach to PLAT-789.
Mira: ok team — next check-in in 48h. If any blocker pops, ping this thread and tag @Mira. :thumbsup:
